summary: FURNISHED DOUBLE ROOM IN PROFESSIONAL SHARED HOUSE My Property Box is pleased to bring to the market this newly renovated, furnished double room in a seven-bedroom shared house of professionals. This double bedroom is located on the second floor, at the front of the house, comes fully furnished, and includes all bills. Also includes Council Tax. The property is situated close to the town centre and has great transport links. The property comprises of Furnished Double Bedroom, Shared Lounge, Shared Fully Fitted Kitchen, and a Shared Bathroom.
